root.body:
**Independent refutation (empirically reproduced): this two-pattern input preserves the `payload-store/` layout — the P1 raised in three rounds is a false positive for this exact input.**

I verified against the actual pinned dependencies: (1) read `actions/upload-artifact@v4.6.2` `src/shared/search.ts` from the tag — `findFilesToUpload` creates **one** globber from the multi-line path input and sets `rootDirectory = globber.getSearchPaths()[0]` when a single search path is returned; (2) reproduced locally with the locked `@actions/glob@0.5.0`: for the two patterns `backend/target/mutation/*.json` + `backend/target/mutation/payload-store/*`, `internal-pattern-helper.getSearchPaths` applies ancestor dedup and returns exactly **one** entry, `backend/target/mutation` (the payload-store literal search path is filtered out because its ancestor is already a candidate).

Consequence: reports upload as `batch-N.edn.json` at the artifact root and blobs as `payload-store/<sha256>`. After `merge-multiple: true` in `qualified`, the evidence directory has exactly the layout `verify-production-mutation-evidence.py` requires. The "first wildcard flattens hierarchy" rule earlier reviews cited applies to a single pattern evaluated alone; with this two-pattern input the common literal ancestor becomes the artifact root. **Please do not change this line** — the current patterns are correct as written, and `docs/verification/production-mutation-qualification.md` is accurate about the merged layout.

source.body:
name: Production Qualification
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      source_ref:
        description: Immutable Knoxx commit to qualify
        required: true
        type: string
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      source_ref:
        description: Immutable Knoxx commit to qualify
        required: true
        type: string
    outputs:
      source_sha:
        description: Commit passing integration, e2e and four mutation batches
        value: ${{ jobs.qualified.outputs.source_sha }}
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  source:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
    outputs:
      sha: ${{ steps.source.outputs.sha }}
      controller_sha: ${{ steps.source.outputs.controller_sha }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          repository: open-hax/knoxx
          ref: main
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - id: source
        env:
          REQUESTED_SHA: ${{ inputs.source_ref }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          binding=$(python3 scripts/verify-production-mutation-evidence.py --prepare-source "$REQUESTED_SHA")
          echo "sha=$(jq -er .source_sha <<< "$binding")" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "controller_sha=$(jq -er .controller_sha <<< "$binding")" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  integration-e2e:
    name: Knoxx integration-e2e
    needs: source
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 90
    services:
      mongodb:
        image: mongodb/mongodb-atlas-local@sha256:5941a11ca0fa4f4ed7ffc6c476253f95449cd96797fbf66a2deade10f54e0cd5
        ports: ['27017:27017']
    env:
      MONGODB_URI: mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/?directConnection=true
      MONGODB_DB: knoxx_production_qualification
      PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH: /usr/bin/google-chrome
      KNOXX_E2E_REQUIRE_DOCKER: 'true'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          repository: open-hax/knoxx
          ref: ${{ needs.source.outputs.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: ./.github/actions/knoxx-setup
      - name: Compile and run integration coverage
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          pnpm -C backend typecheck
          pnpm -C backend test:coverage
          pnpm -C frontend typecheck
          pnpm -C frontend test:coverage
      - name: Real backend end-to-end tests
        run: pnpm -C backend test:e2e
      - name: Browser translation workflow
        run: bash scripts/verify-translation-browser-ci.sh
      - name: Build production artifacts
        run: |
          pnpm -C backend build
          pnpm -C frontend build
  mutation:
    name: Knoxx mutation batch ${{ matrix.batch }}
    needs: [source, integration-e2e]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 360
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        batch: [0, 1, 2, 3]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          repository: open-hax/knoxx
          ref: ${{ needs.source.outputs.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: ./.github/actions/knoxx-setup
      - name: Qualify 250 distinct source mutations with a green baseline
        working-directory: backend
        env:
          BATCH_INDEX: ${{ matrix.batch }}
        run: |
          clojure -M:mutation --run --batch-count 4 --batch-index "$BATCH_INDEX" \
            --limit 250 --min-evaluated 250 --timeout-ms 240000 \
            --equivalents mutation/reviewed-equivalents.edn \
            --report "target/mutation/batch-${BATCH_INDEX}.edn"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: production-mutation-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}-${{ needs.source.outputs.sha }}-${{ matrix.batch }}
          path: |
            backend/target/mutation/*.json
            backend/target/mutation/payload-store/*
          if-no-files-found: error
  # Signing is isolated from application execution and has no always/failure path.
  # The official certificate binds C/G/run-attempt; signed report bytes bind S.
  attest-evidence:
    needs: [source, integration-e2e, mutation]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
      id-token: write
      attestations: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          repository: open-hax/knoxx
          ref: ${{ needs.source.outputs.controller_sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - id: artifacts
        env:
          SOURCE_SHA: ${{ needs.source.outputs.sha }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          EVIDENCE_DIR: ${{ runner.temp }}/production-mutation-signing
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          [[ ! -e "$EVIDENCE_DIR" && ! -L "$EVIDENCE_DIR" ]]
          echo "ids=$(python3 scripts/verify-production-mutation-evidence.py --producer-artifact-ids "$SOURCE_SHA")" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          artifact-ids: ${{ steps.artifacts.outputs.ids }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/production-mutation-signing
          merge-multiple: true
      - id: subjects
        env:
          SOURCE_SHA: ${{ needs.source.outputs.sha }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          EVIDENCE_DIR: ${{ runner.temp }}/production-mutation-signing
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          subjects=$(python3 scripts/verify-production-mutation-evidence.py --attest-subjects "$SOURCE_SHA" "$EVIDENCE_DIR")
          {
            echo 'paths<<REPORT_SUBJECTS'
            printf '%s\n' "$subjects"
            echo REPORT_SUBJECTS
          } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - uses: actions/attest@1e69f48acb82d1966a394da916b4c1698aa569d6 # v4.2.2
        with:
          subject-path: ${{ steps.subjects.outputs.paths }}
          push-to-registry: false
          create-storage-record: false
  qualified:
    needs: [source, integration-e2e, mutation, attest-evidence]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
      attestations: read
    outputs:
      source_sha: ${{ steps.accept.outputs.sha }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          repository: open-hax/knoxx
          ref: ${{ needs.source.outputs.controller_sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          repository: open-hax/knoxx
          ref: ${{ needs.source.outputs.sha }}
          path: application
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '21'
      - uses: DeLaGuardo/setup-clojure@13
        with:
          cli: '1.12.5.1654'
      - name: Require a fresh external evidence directory
        id: artifacts
        env:
          EVIDENCE_DIR: ${{ runner.temp }}/production-mutation-evidence
          SOURCE_SHA: ${{ needs.source.outputs.sha }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          [[ ! -e "$EVIDENCE_DIR" && ! -L "$EVIDENCE_DIR" ]]
          echo "ids=$(python3 scripts/verify-production-mutation-evidence.py --producer-artifact-ids "$SOURCE_SHA")" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          artifact-ids: ${{ steps.artifacts.outputs.ids }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/production-mutation-evidence
          merge-multiple: true
      - id: accept
        env:
          SOURCE_SHA: ${{ needs.source.outputs.sha }}
          EVIDENCE_DIR: ${{ runner.temp }}/production-mutation-evidence
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 scripts/verify-production-mutation-evidence.py "$SOURCE_SHA" "$EVIDENCE_DIR"
          echo "sha=$SOURCE_SHA" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

root.body:
**Independent refutation for the reviewed head: the basis `4db9f45` is a valid ancestor of the qualified source — the P1 was tested against a different target SHA.**

The finding reports `git merge-base --is-ancestor 4db9f45 <f5994a57>` exiting 1 with merge-base `662a1f8`. That target is not this stack: I verified locally at the live head that `git merge-base --is-ancestor 4db9f45d2a0257107f906ed0607304d6b94be173 <head>` exits **0**, and `4db9f45` is the direct parent of `5100fdd` in this branch. This stack merges with merge commits, so after #388 merges, `4db9f45` becomes an ancestor of main and transitively of the deployed source S.

Operationally, the mutation job now checks out with `fetch-depth: 0` (added in this head), so both `git merge-base --is-ancestor <basis> HEAD` and `git show <basis>:backend/src/cljs/knoxx/backend/bootstrap.cljs` resolve in the production job. If a future stack layer were ever squash-merged, the runner fails closed with the explicit "basis must be an ancestor" error before any baseline runs — the safe direction, not a silent acceptance. The manifest is valid as committed; do not repoint the basis.
